block.intro.heading: You were promised a 10x engineering team. You became an unpaid babysitter.
block.intro.body: Every developer knows the sinking feeling. You paste context into three chat windows. You switch tabs frantically, terrified of what breaks the moment you look away. By midnight, one agent refactored your core models while another broke migration history. **The mental tax of policing chaotic AI is eating your life, and it never shows up in any roadmap.**
block.intro.imageAlt: A developer staring at glowing terminal screens late at night, exhausted by endless AI conflicts.
block.intro.caption: The exact moment you realize raw AI intelligence without governance is a dangerous liability.
block.problem.heading: Every time a session closes, your project suffers amnesia
block.problem.body: You type the vision into session one, re-explain it to session two, and watch a third session hallucinate an architecture you rejected yesterday. **Retelling is not engineering. It is entropy.**
block.problem.consequenceLabel: What this chaos really costs you
block.impact.heading: The industry built memory tools that forget 50% of the time
block.impact.body: Independent benchmarks proved that existing AI memory systems fail update accuracy more than half the time. Your agents do not fail at the finish line: they drop critical facts the exact second they are written down.
block.answer.heading: What happens when AI coding agents actually grow up?
block.answer.body: Agent Custom Setup transforms rogue agents into an autonomous software studio. Your repository becomes a living engineering department with an ironclad chain of command, automated review gates, and persistent memory. **One command turns chaotic prompts into unstoppable 24/7 delivery.**
block.acs.heading: Collisions eliminated before code is written
block.acs.body: ACS assigns clear task boundaries, active leadership leases, and automated handoffs. When two agents work in parallel, their scopes are isolated in managed worktrees. **When a strategic architectural choice is required, the human keeps the ultimate veto.**
block.oio.heading: No agent can forge a human decision
block.oio.body: OIO enforces machine-checkable identity stamps on every ticket, proposal, and direction. An agent cannot hallucinate its own opinions into authoritative requirements. **Intent stays human, execution stays autonomous.**
block.pcm.heading: A fresh agent resumes with zero context loss in seconds
block.pcm.body: PCM stores project state, active task boundaries, evidence, and next actions directly inside versioned Git history. Any agent waking up in a new session reads the exact state in one file. **No re-typing. No amnesia. Just continuous forward momentum.**
block.cgm.heading: Engineering output that actually reads like human genius
block.cgm.body: CGM routes documentation, marketing copy, and pull requests through proven human copywriting frameworks. Every claim is tied to verified evidence, eliminating generic AI filler and corporate jargon forever. **Code that sells itself.**
block.train.heading: One certified version train: zero configuration drift
block.train.body: train holds the single certified version matrix for your entire stack. Instead of copying version strings across dozens of files, your entire multi-agent ecosystem updates in unified, rock-solid lockstep. **No broken dependencies. No silent drift.**
block.compare.heading: Raw Chat vs. Autonomous Software Studio
block.compare.body: Without ACS, you juggle fragile chat tabs, pray agents do not clash, and lose entire afternoons to context rebuilds. With ACS, you get an autonomous studio with machine-verified task gates, permanent Git checkpoints, and zero-babysitting reliability.
block.measure.heading: Built on brutal truths, not AI marketing hype
block.measure.body: Every layer of ACS was engineered specifically to solve the empirical failure modes that break other agent platforms: write-time omissions, context rot, and uncoordinated collisions. We do not hide behind vague promises: we enforce machine gates that prove every single claim.
block.measure.tagNote: Engineered to eliminate the empirical failure points of raw LLM memory.
block.boundaries.heading: Absolute human authority over strategic outcomes
block.boundaries.body: Autonomous execution does not mean surrendering control. ACS enforces clear structural guardrails so you always hold the steering wheel:
block.boundaries.items: Strategic decisions, scope changes, and architectural approvals always belong to the human owner.
Every task is strictly bounded before code begins: runaway agents are impossible by design.
Machine-checkable identity stamps ensure no agent can promote an inference into accepted policy.
Auto-merge and verification gates fail closed: unverified code never touches default branches.
block.boundaries.proof: Engineered for builders who demand autonomous scale without losing architectural control.
block.next.heading: Ship features while you sleep. Stop babysitting today.

research.heading: The Empirical Collapse of Raw Agent Memory
research.intro: Academic benchmarks exposed why raw agent setups constantly fail: memory update accuracy collapses below 50% across every major platform. The damage happens the moment facts are written.
research.pcm.chartNote: Dashed line marks the 50% failure threshold.
research.pcm.heading: Existing memory tools drop facts 50% to 94% of the time
research.pcm.body: PCM replaces fragile vector memory with deterministic Git-backed repository state. While commercial memory products drop half their updates, Git state is permanent, versioned, and infallible.
research.pcm.chartTitle: Memory update accuracy failed to clear 50% across every system tested
research.pcm.chartSubtitle: Memory update accuracy across five leading agent memory tools (HaluMem benchmark)
research.pcm.chartCaption: Omission rates in standard benchmarks range from 52% to 94%. Flawed extraction propagates errors through every subsequent reasoning step. PCM eliminates extraction failure by using deterministic Git records.
research.pcm.chartAlt: Horizontal bars showing memory update accuracy: Zep 47.3 percent, Mem0 25.5 percent, Mem0-Graph 24.5 percent, Supermemory 16.4 percent, Memobase 5.2 percent. A reference line at 50 percent is above every bar.
research.pcm.statWriteLabel: of memory failures occur at initial write time
research.pcm.statExtractLabel: points lost to extraction versus verbatim storage
research.pcm.statExtractBody: Extraction costs up to 22.0 benchmark points compared with storing raw project facts directly into versioned files.
research.oio.heading: 90% of agent platforms cannot prove who wrote what
research.oio.body: OIO embeds cryptographic, machine-checkable filer stamps directly onto every issue and ticket. An agent cannot invent requirements or masquerade as a human director.
research.oio.chartTitle: Only thirteen tools out of seventy-three track claim truth status
research.oio.chartSubtitle: Systems that store an explicit truth status on items, counted by cluster
research.oio.chartCaption: Thirteen named exceptions out of seventy-three systems. Everything else in the market relies on untracked, free-form tags with zero verification.
research.oio.chartAlt: Bars counting named exceptions by cluster: PKM and markdown tools 5, hosted and open-source memory products 3, formal foundations 5.
research.acs.heading: Long context guarantees amnesia without active governance
research.acs.body: At one million tokens of conversational history, omission rates soar to 98%. ACS eliminates token exhaustion by keeping task scopes tightly bounded in clean, dedicated worktrees.
research.acs.chartTitle: Omission rates hit 98% in long-context agent conversations
research.acs.chartSubtitle: Upper end of omission ranges reported by HaluMem at 1M-token histories
research.acs.chartCaption: Without rigid task boundaries, agents lose up to 98% of critical facts. ACS bypasses chat limits by isolating active work in clean, dedicated task trees.
research.acs.chartAlt: Two bars at one-million-token histories: correct updates up to 37 percent, omissions up to 98 percent.
research.acs.regimeNote: No two commercial memory tools agree on how to resolve contradictory facts.
research.acs.statVisibilityLabel: best model accuracy when catching an explicit contradiction
research.cgm.heading: Adding unverified memory multiplies sycophancy by 25x
research.cgm.body: Studies show that raw vector memory increases model sycophancy from 1.6% to 40.2%. CGM forces every generated claim to cite verifiable repository evidence, stopping hallucinated agreement cold.
research.cgm.chartTitle: Model sycophancy jumped from 1.6% to 40.2% when raw memory was introduced
research.cgm.chartSubtitle: Sycophancy rate for frontier models: raw chat history versus vector memory
research.cgm.chartCaption: Memory extraction introduces systemic bias across multiple model families. CGM stops sycophancy by requiring explicit repository citations for every factual assertion.
research.cgm.chartAlt: Two bars for one model: 1.6 percent sycophancy with chat history, 40.2 percent with Mem0 memory.

prd.title: The Autonomous Studio Architecture
prd.lede: Five decoupled layers that give coding agents shared persistent memory, machine-verified identity, and automated release gates. Here is how it works.
prd.what.heading: Five specialized layers, one unstoppable engineering studio
prd.what.body: ACS gives every coding agent on any machine the exact same high-definition picture of your project: active goals, verified evidence, task boundaries, and next actions. **Agents handle relentless execution. You command the ship.**
prd.today.heading: The fatal flaw of raw agent chat sessions
prd.today.body: Raw coding agents exist in an ephemeral bubble. The moment a conversation window closes, its memory evaporates. The next session starts blind, retells the story with slight inaccuracies, and eventually corrupts the codebase. ACS ends this cycle forever.
prd.layers.heading: The five decoupled governance layers
prd.layers.body: Each layer is an independent, specialized authority. Together, they form an unshakeable foundation for autonomous software delivery.
prd.research.heading: Three numbers that expose raw agent fragility
prd.research.body: Standard commercial memory tools drop half their facts, long context causes 98% omission, and unverified history explodes model sycophancy.
prd.soWhat.write: Permanent Git checkpoints guarantee zero memory loss across sessions.
prd.soWhat.staleness: Active task leasing stops agent collisions before a line of code is written.
prd.soWhat.pin: A single certified release train prevents version drift across your ecosystem.
prd.next.heading: Explore the constellation and choose your workflow
prd.next.body: Inspect the seventeen failure modes solved by ACS, or deploy the multi-agent hotloader directly into your repository.
prd.details.heading: Architectural Specifications and Guarantees
prd.details.body: Explore the exact mechanics: identity stamps, bounded task isolation, Git-native continuity, and fail-closed CI gates.
prd.howto.heading: Transparent, verifiable citations
prd.howto.body: Every claim in this architecture points to open-source code, active unit tests, or peer-reviewed research papers.
prd.revisions.heading: Certified Revisions
prd.revisions.note: Locked and certified through the unified release train.
prd.edges.heading: Decoupled authority, unified execution
prd.edges.body: ACS executes tasks without modifying tickets. OIO governs identity and issue ops. PCM anchors permanent memory into Git. CGM crafts human-grade documentation. train enforces unified release versioning.
prd.problems.heading: Seventeen solved failure points
prd.problems.body: Each documented bottleneck pairs with the precise structural mechanism that eliminates it.
prd.mechanism.heading: Where the governance actually bites
prd.mechanism.body: Three structural breakthroughs make ACS bulletproof: 1) Machine-checkable filer stamps prevent agents from faking human authorization. 2) Git-native continuity gives every fresh session instant total recall. 3) Fail-closed CI gates and push receipts guarantee that delivered code is verified code.
prd.decisions.heading: Strategic decisions remain 100% human
prd.decisions.body: Agents break down work, claim tickets, and ship code through verified tests. You decide what gets built, what quality bar is required, and which direction wins. The machine executes the work; you retain the vision.
prd.parked.heading: Continuous evolutionary design
prd.parked.body: When automated tie-breaking between agents encounters ambiguous trade-offs, ACS escalates immediately to the human director. We treat explicit human judgment as the gold standard of system integrity.
prd.limits.heading: The standard of verifiable engineering
prd.limits.body: Every claim we make is grounded in published empirical research and verifiable open-source code. We do not sell magical black boxes: we deliver inspectable, dependable systems that work.
